day_local: Sabtida Toddobaadkii Labaatan iyo Shanaad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential:
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
Kiristoow, noo naxariiso.
Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbiyow, jiilba jiilka ka dambeeya waxaad noo ahayd magangalyo.
homily:
Waxaa jira waxyaabo yaryar oo nolosha qofka ka dhiga mid macno leh, waxyaabo aan inta badan iska indho-tirno ilaa ay xilligoodu dhaafaan. Waxaan maanta maskaxdayda ku hayaa sawirka Ben oo si taxaddar leh u dhex socda garoonka diyaaradaha, isagoo indhihiisa waaweyn ee wax-raadiyaha ah ku eegaya diyaaradaha Boeing 737 ee ku sii jeeda cirka. Ma ahayn kaliya xiiso uu u qabay mashiinnada; waxay ahayd xiiso uu u qabay dunida ballaadhan ee uu Ilaah abuuray. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu wax walba u arko sida qurux, sida fursad, iyo sida waddo uu ku gaari karo wax ka sarreeya xuduudaha dhulka. Waxa uu lahaa maskax aad u fiiqan, laakiin waxa uu lahaa qalbi ka sii weyn.

Akhriska koowaad ee maanta, oo ka yimid Kitaabka Qohaleed, wuxuu inoo sheegayaa: 'Xusuuso Abuurahaaga maalmaha dhalinyaradaada.' Qoraagu wuxuu inoo sawirayaa wareegga nolosha: waqti la beero iyo waqti la goosto, waqti la ooyo iyo waqti la qoslo. Markaan eegno nolosha Benjamin Vo, oo ahayd mid gaaban laakiin aad u qoto dheer, waxaan dareemeynaa in saacadaha dunidu ay u muuqdaan kuwo aan sinnayn. Waxaan is-weydiinnaa: 'Muxuu waqtiga Ben u gaabnaaday? Maxaynu u dhex fadhiisannaa aamusnaan aan la filayn?' Laakiin Kitaabku wuxuu inoo xusuusinayaa in Ilaah uu 'wax walba qurux u yeelay xilligooda.' Tani ma aha mid inoo sahlaysa inaan fahanno xanuunka, laakiin waxay inoo sheegaysaa in nolosha Ben aysan ahayn mid khasaartay. Waxay ahayd nolol dhammaystiran, nolol uu Ilaah u qorsheeyay waqti gaar ah oo uu ku iftiimiyo qalbiyadeenna.

Injiilka maanta wuxuu inoo sheegayaa Ciise oo xertiisa u sheegaya: 'Dadka dhegaysta waxaan idiin sheegayo: Wiilka Aadanaha waa in loo dhiibaa gacanta dadka.' Laakiin xertii way cabsanayeen inay weydiiyaan waxa uu wado. Waxay ahayd aamusnaan culus. Waxay ahayd aamusnaan ay ka buuxdo cabsi iyo jahwareer. Maanta, waxaan la hadlayaa qalbiyadiinna oo dareemaya aamusnaantaas guriga dhexdiisa ah. Waxaan la hadlayaa Alan iyo Thao, oo saddexdan biloodba dareemayay sida buur culus oo saaran xabadka. Waxaan ogahay in habeenkii, marka aad eegto sawirrada Ben, aad is-weydiinaysaan: 'Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan maanta dhex fadhiisto xanuunkaas idinkala socda oo aan idiin sheego si cad: Waxba ma aad seegin. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Xanuunka iyo dhimashada aan la fileynin ee soo martay Ben ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise ugu jawaabay markii la weydiiyay sababta uu ninku u dhashay indhoolaha: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Jacaylka aad Ben siisateen—sheekooyinkii, safarradii, iyo xanaanadii aad u haysay—wuxuu ahaa nuurka dhabta ah ee noloshiisa.

Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay inuu bixiyo. Xusuuso markuu ahaa 15 sano jir, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas safka hore kaga jiray ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa xigmadda dhabta ah ee Masiixu inoo sheegayo. Taasi waa jacayl aan xisaab lahayn, jacayl aan sugin mahadcelin, jacayl si fudud u bixiya naftiisa. Ben wuxuu baray qoyskiisa in jacaylku aanu ahayn waxa aad haysato, laakiin waa waxa aad diyaar u tahay inaad bixiso. Waxa uu lahaa riyooyin waaweyn, sida 'Con Chim Airlines', laakiin riyadii ugu weynayd waxay ahayd inuu qof walba farxad geliyo.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in dunidaadu ay isbeddeshay. Waxaan ogahay in kursiga agtaada ah uu mararka qaarkood u muuqdo mid madhan. Laakiin xusuuso, Ben wuxuu kula joogaa jacaylka aad u hayso. Sida uu kuugu sheegay riyadaada, halkaas oo aad ku wada raacdeen 'roller coaster', xidhiidhka idinka dhexeeya wuu sii socdaa. Ha ka cabsan inaad noolaato, ha ka cabsan inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad faraxdo. Wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa.

Markaad ka baxaysaan meeshan maanta, qaado hal shay oo yar: Ha ku tiirsanaan xigmaddaada marka culaysku yimaado. U dhiib qalbigaaga Ciise. Ha joojiso inaad is-eedeyso. Ogow in Ben uu ku jiro nabadda iyo gacmaha Aabbaha, oo uu halkaas idinku sugayo. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay meel nabdoon, wuxuuna idin leeyahay: 'Haku murugoonina si xad dhaaf ah; waan idin daawanayaa.' Ha iloobin in jacaylka Ben uu weli ku nool yahay adduunkan. Sida ceelka biyaha ee Cà Mau, ee uu magaciisa ku qoran yahay, jacaylkiisu wuxuu u socdaa dadka harraadsan, isagoo u keenaya nolol iyo rajo. Sidaas oo kale, qalbiyadiinna ha u furnaadaan rajo cusub. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad ku sugantahay Sakramentka Quduuska ah. Waxaan kaa jeclahay wax walba, waxaana rabaa inaan naftayda ku siiyo. Maadaama aanan hadda kugu qaadan karin Sakramentka, fadlan igu soo booqo ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan kugu soo dhaweynayaa sidii inaad horey u timid, waxaana naftayda si buuxda kuugu dhiibayaa. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa fogaado. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idinku barakeeyo, ha idin ilaaliyo, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa. Nabadda Masiix ha idinla jirto.
standing_petitions: Wiilkeenna Ben iyo dhammaan kuwii ka horreeyay ee dhintay, inuu Rabbigu siiyo nabad iyo iftiin weligeed ah, waxaan Rabbiga ka baryaynaa.
Dhammaan qoysaska murugaysan iyo kuwa culeyska wada, inuu Ilaah u soo dejiyo rajo iyo xoog, waxaan Rabbiga ka baryaynaa.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Farax, wiilyahow, intaad dhalinyarada tahay, oo qalbigaagu ha ku rayreeyo maalmaha dhalinyaradaada. Raac waddooyinka qalbigaaga iyo aragtida indhahaaga; laakiin ogow in waxaas oo dhan Ilaah kuu keeni doono xukun. Murugada ka fogee qalbigaaga, dhibkana ka fogee joogitaankaaga, in kastoo waaberiga dhalinyaradu uu yahay mid dhaafaya. Xusuuso Abuurahaaga maalmaha dhalinyaradaada, ka hor intaanay iman maalmaha sharka ah, iyo sannadaha soo dhowaanaya ee aad dhihi doonto, 'Kuma raaxaysto iyaga'; ka hor intaan qorraxda, iyo iftiinka, iyo dayaxa, iyo xiddiguhu madoobaan, inta daruuruhu soo noqonayaan roobka dabadiis; markaan waardiyayaasha gurigu gariirayaan, oo raggii xoogga badnaa ay foorarsanayaan, iyo kuwa wax shiidaya oo shaqo joojinaya maxaa yeelay way yar yihiin, iyo kuwa daaqadaha wax ka eegaya oo indho-beelaya; markaan albaabbada waddada la xirayo, oo dhawaaqa mishiinku uu hooseeyo; markaan qofku sugayo dhawaaqa shimbirta, laakiin dhammaan gabdhihii heesaha la aamusinayo; markaan qofku ka cabsanayo meelaha dhaadheer, iyo khataraha waddada; markaan geedka yicibta ubaxayo, oo ayaxuna uu gaabinayo, oo midhaha caper-ku ay saameyn la'aan yihiin, maxaa yeelay ninku wuxuu u socdaa gurigiisii weligiis, oo baroortayaashuna waxay ku wareegayaan waddooyinka; ka hor intaan xadhigga qalinku go'in, oo baaquli dahabka ah la jebin, iyo weelka biyaha oo lagu jebin ilaha agtooda, iyo xadhigga mishiinka oo ku dhacaya ceelka, iyo boodhka oo ku noqonaya dhulka siday markii hore ahaan jireen, iyo neefta nolosha oo ku noqonaysa Ilaah oo bixiyay. Waanida waaniddeeda, ayuu leeyahay Qohaleed, wax walba waa waanid!

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: R. (1) Rabbiyow, jiilba jiilka ka dambeeya waxaad noo ahayd magangalyo. Waxaad dadka u celisaa boodhka, adigoo leh, 'Ku noqda, carruurta dadka.' Waayo kun sano oo indhahaaga hortooda ah waa sida shalay oo kale, markay dhaaftay, ama sida habeenkii waardiyadiisa. R. Rabbiyow, jiilba jiilka ka dambeeya waxaad noo ahayd magangalyo. Waxaad ku dhammaystaa iyaga hurdada; subaxda xigta waxay u eg yihiin cawska isbeddelaya, oo waaberiga soo baxaya, laakiin fiidkii engega oo engega. R. Rabbiyow, jiilba jiilka ka dambeeya waxaad noo ahayd magangalyo. Ina bar sida loo tiriyo maalmaheenna, si aan u helno xigmad qalbi. Rabbiyow, noo soo noqo! Ilaa goormaan? U naxariiso addoommadaada! R. Rabbiyow, jiilba jiilka ka dambeeya waxaad noo ahayd magangalyo. Naga buuxi waaberiga naxariistaada, si aan ugu qaylinno farxad iyo rayrayn maalmaheenna oo dhan. Oo daryeelka naxariista leh ee Rabbiga Ilaaheenna ha noo ahaado; shaqada gacmaheenna noo barakee! Shaqada gacmaheenna barakee! R. Rabbiyow, jiilba jiilka ka dambeeya waxaad noo ahayd magangalyo.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Intay dhammaantood la yaabanaayeen camalkiisa kasta, Ciise wuxuu xertiisa ku yidhi, 'Dhegaysta waxaan idiin sheegayo. Wiilka Aadanaha waa in loo dhiibaa gacanta dadka.' Laakiin iyagu ma ay fahmin hadalkan; macnihiisu wuu ka qarsoonaa si aysan u fahmin, wayna ka cabsanayeen inay weydiiyaan hadalkan.

day: Saturday of the Twenty-Fifth Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.

Ben ơi, Làm cả ngày tới tối, đến lúc chuẩn bị đi ngủ thì nằm một lúc lại nhớ Ben, nhớ mấy chuyện hai anh em từng nói với nhau. Nghĩ tới em, anh thấy buồn nhiều lắm. Ben hãy luôn theo dõi và cầu nguyện cho ba mẹ và Ryan nhé, nước mắt chảy ngược nó khủng khiếp hơn chảy xuôi đó Ben.

Ben ơi, ba nhớ con nhiều quá.

Mommy cũng vậy. Hơn hai tháng rồi mà ba má vẫn khóc mỗi ngày.

Con giúp ba má vượt qua nha, để lo cho em
Hey Ben,  nếu có thể hãy cho anh Minh gặp Ben trong giấc mơ nhé, dù chỉ là lời chào hay nụ cười như cách Ben vẫn hay tạo dáng để chụp hình. Nhớ và thương Ben nhiều lắm
